environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 behind an ALB with public-facing target group. ALB forwards all traffic directly to the application on port 8000. No CloudFront distribution in front. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB. Session cookies set with SameSite=None to support mobile app clients. No origin header validation at application or infrastructure level.

config.load_balancer: ALB public-facing, listener 443 -> target group port 8000
